title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP05a-change — accept only base-verified authorization consumption in the trusted Diff
goal: Let the trusted Diff accept the deletion of a change-trusted-base authorization only when the base candidate verifier confirms that the change consumes it, cover Diff and candidate verification end to end with negative cases, and consume the CP05a-auth authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: The runner runs the base verifier in authorization-only mode against the pull request head and passes only a verified consumed record to the Diff stage, which exempts only its plain deletion in a committed range.

Renames, other protected deletions, unconsumed authorization deletions, mismatched changes and injected GUARD_CONSUMED_AUTHORIZATIONS values keep failing, and Test-IFXTrustedBase -DiffConsumptionOnly runs in v3-architecture.
The pull request deletes the consumed authorization, candidate verification passes, and only v3-pre-diff fails under the pre-fix base, as required for the D20 break-glass.
All other guard tests pass and the 13 required check names are unchanged.
